# pve_filerestore_list (Data Source)

File-restore listing of a backup volume (optionally under one path).

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "pve_filerestore_list" "example" {
filepath = "CHANGE_ME"
node = "pve1"
storage = "local"
volume = "CHANGE_ME"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `filepath` (String) base64-path to the directory or file being listed, or "/".
- `node` (String) The cluster node name.
- `storage` (String) The storage identifier.
- `volume` (String) Backup volume ID or name. Currently only PBS snapshots are supported.

### Read-Only

- `entries` (Attributes List) Returned by /nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/file-restore/list. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--entries))
- `id` (String) Identifier: <node>/<storage>.

<a id="nestedatt--entries"></a>
### Nested Schema for `entries`

Read-Only:

- `filepath` (String) base64 path of the current entry
- `leaf` (Boolean) If this entry is a leaf in the directory graph.
- `mtime` (Number) Entry last-modified time (unix timestamp).
- `size` (Number) Entry file size.
- `text` (String) Entry display text.
- `type` (String) Entry type.
